title: Central Coast Outdoors

services.name: Kayak Day Trip
services.desc: Kayaking through the wildlife filled waters of Morro Bay in the morning and then having a gourmet picnic lunch on the pristine sand dunes at mid day is truly a memorable experience. After launching, our exact kayaking route may vary depending on tides and recent wildlife activity, but includes possible visits to a seal haul out area, a heron rookery, and an oyster farm, as well as chances to see otters. Later in the morning, we beach our kayaks on a secluded part of the sand dunes. Digging your toes in the sand, you can simply enjoy this magical environment or opt for a short climb over the dunes to stunning ocean views up and done miles of isolated beach. Back on the bay side of the dunes

services.name: Sunset Two Hour
services.desc: Morro Bay at dusk is a magical time to be on the water. This short version of our private sunset paddle series starts a bit later than our other sunset paddles and stays exclusively on the water. Our exact route is dependent on tides, weather conditions and recent wildlife activity. We might visit a seal haul out area, an oyster farm and/or the heron preserve. It’s always possible to sea otters as well. We’ll pause on the water to say goodbye to the sun before returning to the docks. On foggy days, the sunset won’t be as spectacular, but the sense of peace on the water as daylight fades is possibly even more dramatic. blurb: Morro Bay is an amazing kayaking destination. The bay is part of the National Estuary Program and is also recognized as an Important Bird Area by the Audubon Society. The wildlife here is truly phenomenal and includes not just birds, but several species of marine mammals. Native American history runs deep in Morro Bay as well.
